replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived promoter state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in Drosophila promoters (n = 5912 promoters).
outputs.explanation: The panel aggregates data across 5912 Drosophila promoters, and both the number (n = 5912) and the type of unit (promoters) are explicitly stated in the caption.

The panel quantifies promoter state frequencies (percentages) derived from a population of 2952 single DNA molecules at this locus; the number and type of underlying observations are stated directly on the panel.

replicate_statements: Distribution of SMF-derived state frequencies as a function of Pol II ChIP-seq level in mouse promoters (n = 6122 promoters).
outputs.explanation: The panel aggregates data across 6122 mouse promoters, and both the number and type of unit (promoters) are explicitly stated in the caption.

The panel quantifies promoter state frequencies derived from a population of 2871 single DNA molecules at this mouse locus; the number and type of underlying observations are stated directly on the panel.

replicate_statements: mouse (TATA-less n = 572 promoters; TATA-containing n = 64 promoters) and Drosophila (TATA-less n = 422 promoters; TATA-containing n = 71 promoters) promoters
The statistical comparisons between groups were performed using the Wilcoxon rank-sum test.
outputs.explanation: Boxplots with a stated statistical test require n reporting; the caption gives explicit n numbers for each group (minimum n = 64) and identifies the unit as promoters.
